rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 6 March 1991, under 'Announcement about Prime Minister's resignation', the Leader of the House, Shri Yashwant Sinha, informs the House that the Prime Minister has announced in the other House that he is calling on the President to tender the resignation of his Government, and that the Prime Minister is on his way to Rashtrapati Bhavan to tender his own resignation and that of the Council of Ministers; the House adjourns at 14.36 until 11.00 on 7 March.
